description: Graphviz dot rejects unquoted attribute names containing dots (e.g. human.question) with 'syntax error near .'; qualitygate's graph-parse arm uses dot -Tcanon, so fabro workflow graphs must write dotted attrs as quoted names: "human.question"=... (quoted IDs are standard DOT and parse everywhere). Found via seeds-a77c tester red in run 01M33WZF2KMHMP9W8RPJ0SB5X2.
resolution: Quote every dotted attribute name in workflow.fabro node blocks; verified dot -Tcanon parses both graphs after the fix.
